sources.snippet: 🌟 Model Overview This repository hosts high-quality ConvRot INT8 quantized weights for all-in-one ControlNet Union and dedicated ControlNet models. By applying orthogonal Hadamard rotation prior to per-channel INT8 quantization, these models effectively eliminate activation outlier distortion and drastically reduce VRAM and disk footprint while preserving precise structural control fidelity:
